welcome.title: Welcome to Supervisor Schedule!
welcome.description: This tool helps you generate and validate rotation schedules for drilling supervisors. Let's take a quick tour.

presets.title: Predefined Configurations
presets.description: Use these buttons to load common configurations. Each preset has optimized values for different work regimes.
presets.descriptionNoData: Click on any of these presets to load a predefined configuration and generate an example schedule. We recommend starting with the 14x7 Regime.

configForm.title: Schedule Configuration
configForm.description: Here you define the key parameters: work days, off days, induction days, and required drilling days. All fields are automatically validated.

generateButton.title: Generate Schedule
generateButton.description: Once parameters are configured, press this button to generate the schedule. The system will automatically optimize the supervisor rotation.
generateButton.descriptionNoData: Press this button to generate your first schedule. You can use a preset or configure the values manually.

validation.title: Validation Summary
validation.description: Here you'll see if the schedule meets all requirements. Warnings or errors are shown if something needs adjustment.

scheduleGrid.title: Generated Schedule
scheduleGrid.description: This table shows the daily rotation of the three supervisors (S1, S2, S3) and the drilling day counter. You can export to PDF, Excel, or CSV.

stats.title: Schedule Statistics
stats.description: Expand this section to see detailed charts and metrics: utilization rate, drilling efficiency, and day distribution per supervisor.

history.title: Schedule History
history.description: All generated schedules are temporarily saved here. You can reload them or export them later.
history.descriptionNoData: Once you generate schedules, they will appear saved here. This allows you to review and compare different configurations.

controls.title: App Controls
controls.description: Here you can enable comparison mode to view two configurations side by side, change language, and toggle between light/dark theme.

finish.title: All set!
finish.description: You now know the main features. You can repeat this tour anytime from the settings menu. Let's get to work!
finish.descriptionNoData: You now know the basic interface. Now click on a preset and generate your first schedule to explore all features. You can repeat this tour anytime.

hint.title: New components available!
hint.description: The schedule has been generated. You can now see the validation, complete schedule, and statistics. Click this button to continue the tour from where you left off.
